page: Microsoft Azure L32as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. This virtual machine is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 32 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A key hardware characteristic of the L32as_v5 is its integrated local storage, consisting of a 7679 GB NVMe SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for additional high-throughput disk attachments. No dedicated GPU hardware is present on this server type, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of local NVMe SSD storage paired with a substantial memory allocation makes this server type suitable for workloads requiring high-speed local data access without the latency of remote storage. The hardware configuration is designed for large databases, transactional databases, big data analytics, and memory-intensive applications that benefit from large local scratch space.
description: Microsoft Azure L32as_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the Lasv5 server family, powered by dedicated AMD processors and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The server is equipped with a substantial 7679 GB local NVMe SSD and is Premium Storage capable, though it lacks GPU accelerators and complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile provides high resource density, particularly for local storage and memory capacity. Consequently, the L32as_v5 is structured for storage-heavy and memory-intensive workloads, such as large-scale relational databases, transactional systems, and data analytics pipelines that require rapid read and write access to massive local datasets.
